name: Rahul Sharma
comment: Absolutely breathtaking! Seeing the Taj Mahal at sunrise is a memory I will never forget. A must-visit.

name: Priya Patel
comment: Beautiful architecture, but it gets very crowded in the afternoon. Try to go early morning for the best photos.

name: Amit Kumar
comment: The heart of Hyderabad! The street food around Charminar is amazing. Don't forget to try the Irani Chai.
